description: Activate when: user says 'use an AI agent for outreach / cold email', 'automate lead follow-up', 'multi-touch nurture sequence', 'personalized prospecting emails', asks 'how do we let the agent send email without it looking like spam?', or is designing an agent-driven outbound and lead-nurturing process. Do NOT activate when: sending newsletters to existing subscribers (ordinary email marketing); there is no defined ICP; compliance preconditions for the target region or channel are not met (e.g., no lawful basis for the personal data). More: deciqai.com/c/agent-outreach-lead-nurturing
